QF.id: SIA Assessment Frameworks Techniques and Standards_7

question.text: Under the IMP CONTRIBUTION dimension, the assessor compares the observed change against:

answer.text: The fraction of outcome attributable to partners or co-implementers
The fraction of outcome produced at the expense of another group
The fraction of outcome that fades away over time post-intervention
What would likely occur anyway in the absence of the intervention

explanation.text: The Logic: The IMP CONTRIBUTION dimension asks how the SE's effort compares with what would likely occur anyway. The assessor uses this comparison to judge how much of the observed change can reasonably be linked to the intervention rather than to background trends or other actors. The Trap: Attribution to partners, displacement at the expense of another group, and fade-out of benefits over time are separate considerations and are not what the CONTRIBUTION dimension itself compares against. Note: Document the contribution comparison explicitly in the engagement plan: state what would likely have occurred anyway and how the observed outcome differs from that baseline.
